001: """Average Value per Model from input.csv into summary.xlsx.

027:             counts[model] = counts.get(model, 0) + 1
028:     book = Workbook()
029:     sheet = book.active
030:     sheet.title = "summary"
031:     sheet.append(["Model", "Average", "ValidCount"])
032:     for model in sorted(totals):
033:         sheet.append([model, totals[model] / counts[model], counts[model]])
034:     book.save(args.output)
